title: Vade skill proposal payload (C-13)
description: Frozen contract C-13. The request body of `skill/proposal` (module -> core). A proposal is a suggestion, never an install: it can only land in <data_dir>/skills/pending/<name>/, is never injected into a prompt and never appears in `skill_catalog` until a human approves it through C3b's SkillLoader. The payload carries a whole SKILL.md plus the revision it was written against; `base_revision` is what makes a stale proposal detectable instead of silently clobbering a newer skill.

base_revision.meaning: The revision the proposal was authored against, i.e. the `revision` integer in <data_dir>/skills/<name>/meta.json of the ACTIVE skill at the moment the proposal was written. A pending proposal never advances it: two proposals against revision 3 both say 3, and the second one supersedes the first rather than stacking.
base_revision.create: must be absent or 0. A `create` whose name already exists as an active skill is TOOL_CONFLICT; a `create` on a name that only exists as a pending proposal is allowed and supersedes that pending directory.
base_revision.patch: required and must equal the active revision at intake. A mismatch is TOOL_CONFLICT and the message MUST carry the actual revision so the caller can re-read and re-propose instead of guessing. A patch with no active skill to patch is NOT_FOUND.
base_revision.approve: approval is refused with TOOL_CONFLICT when the pending SKILL.md sha256 differs from the one recorded in pending/<name>/meta.json at intake: an edited pending file is a new proposal, not an approval.

secret_scan.stricter_than_loader: C3b only warns on a secret-shaped body because skills come from the local disk and a manual may legitimately quote a fake key. A proposal comes from a model, so the same shapes are a hard rejection here.

provenance.derived_from: recorded verbatim in pending/<name>/meta.json; it is how a reviewer sees which session/turns/model produced the proposal

name.description: Skill name; also the directory name under skills/pending/.

content.description: The whole SKILL.md, frontmatter included. The body (after frontmatter) is capped separately at body_max_chars.
